subject: Re: Frankfurt-dedicated-compliance-pilot for LexBank - Sizing & timeline
messages:
From: Oliver Strauss <oliver.strauss@lexbank.de>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: marta.ruiz@lexbank.de
Date: 2026-11-21T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Dedicated inference in Frankfurt - pilot ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. LexBank is preparing a small production pilot for a regulated payments workflow and we need a dedicated inference deployment inside the EU (Frankfurt). Key asks: data residency (logs off by default), HSM/KMS key control, and SOC2 evidence.

Traffic profile: 50k requests/day initially, 80% chat-style short responses (~80 tokens), 20% longer generation (up to 512 tokens) for reports. Peak concurrent sessions expected ~120. We need an initial committed pool for 3 months (pilot), with an option to scale after a successful acceptance test.

Can Redwood provide a rough sizing, latency targets, and a preliminary SOW? Procurement will need cost breakout and a tentative timeline for build + validation.

Oliver
Head of Engineering, LexBank

Attachment: lexbank-compliance-checklist-v1.pdf (see items 2, 4, 7)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Strauss <oliver.strauss@lexbank.de>; Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lexbank.de>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21T10:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated inference in Frankfurt - pilot ask

Hi Oliver / Marta —

Appreciate the clear requirements. We can support a EU-only dedicated pool in Frankfurt with KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 evidence via our compliance pack. I'll loop in Connor and Naomi for sizing and SOW details.

High-level proposal (quick turn):
- Pilot commit: 3 months, target throughput 50k requests/day.
- Suggested pool: 8x A100-80GB-class GPUs (quantized model option available) to meet concurrent sessions/latency targets with a 30% buffer for peaks.
- Expected p95 generation latency (chat ~80 tokens): ~120-160ms token latency, end-to-end ~250-350ms depending on network and client batching.
- Optional burst policy to our hosted fallback within EU region if sustained load grows beyond pool capacity.

I'll send a sizing workbook and SOW draft by EOD. Next step: can we schedule a 30-minute call with your procurement/legal and our security lead (Naomi) tomorrow?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed-frankfurt-dimensions.xlsx (stub)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai; naomi_feldman@redwood.ai; markus_klein@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T09:05:00+01:00
Subject: FW: Dedicated inference in Frankfurt - pilot ask (internal sizing)

Team —

Quick internal sizing notes after reviewing Oliver's traffic profile and Vanessa's suggestion:

1) Base model/latency tradeoffs - If LexBank accepts 8x A100-80GB with int8 quantization we can likely hit the throughput and keep costs lower. Without quantization we should consider 12x to maintain p95 latency under load for 512-token runs.
2) KV/prefix caching - Their mix (many short chat sessions) benefits from per-customer KV caching. We'll want 200-300GB of KV cache allocation across the pool.
3) Network + DR - Recommend colocating control plane in EU-W (Frankfurt) with a passive DR region in EU-C (Amsterdam) with replication of KV snapshots every 10 minutes. This satisfies our internal SRE suggestion for resilience.
4) Compliance deliverables - Naomi: you'll need to confirm KMS/HSM vendor compatibility and exact audit evidence LexBank requires.

Risk items: procurement window may add 2–3 weeks for their legal. Also, if they require dedicated tenancy (bare-metal), timeline extends by 3–4 weeks.

Action items:
- Naomi: confirm KMS/HSM compatibility and list of SOC2 artifacts we can provide.
- Laura: draft an SRE onboarding checklist for Frankfurt dedicated pools (network, backup, monitoring, runbooks).
- Vanessa/Connor: schedule a call with LexBank procurement (proposed tomorrow 14:00 CET).

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Strauss <oliver.strauss@lexbank.de>; Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lexbank.de>; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai; connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T11:17:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated inference in Frankfurt - pilot ask (compliance & timeline)

Hi Oliver / Marta —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. A few clarifications from a compliance perspective:
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS + CloudHSM (Frankfurt region). If LexBank uses an on-prem HSM, we can integrate via PKCS#11 gateway — will need network configuration details.
- Audit evidence: We can supply SOC2 Type II report redacted for customer-specific data, encryption configuration export, access logs for the dedicated pool (retention window configurable), and quarterly penetration test summary.
- Data retention: We will switch off persistent request logs by default for the pool and provide a configurable retention window (7 / 30 / 90 days).

Timeline estimate (assuming no bare-metal requirement):
- Contract sign + procurement clearance: 1–3 weeks
- Pool provisioning & network setup (Frankfurt): 2 weeks
- Security integration + tests (KMS + log config): 1 week
- Acceptance testing (customer): 1 week

Total: ~5–7 weeks from signed SOW. If bare-metal tenancy required, add 3–4 weeks to provisioning.

I'll attach a checklist of the specific artifacts LexBank should expect.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sow-draft-20261124.docx (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lexbank.de>

Cc: Oliver Strauss <oliver.strauss@lexbank.de>; eurocloud-sales@eurocloud.eu
Date: 2026-11-24T16:29:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated inference in Frankfurt - pilot ask

Thanks Vanessa / Naomi / Connor —

This looks good and aligns with our internal risk posture. A few procurement notes:
- We prefer software tenancy but will confirm by end of week.
- We need a clear cost breakout: committed monthly fee (3-month pilot), per-token overage, and a monthly support SLO cost. Can you provide those numbers in the SOW?
- EuroCloud (copied) will assist with network peering and cross-check HSM connectivity.

If you can send the draft SOW and an itemized cost sheet tomorrow, we can target signature within 10 business days. Also please include the acceptance test criteria (latency p95 thresholds, functional tests).

Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager, LexBank GmbH
